description: Monorepo members that are released and distributed but never deployed to the Extra Chill network. They have no deploy attachment in extrachill-monorepo.json, so `homeboy deploy extrachill-monorepo` never installs them on the server.

components.reason: Partner WordPress plugin installed on partner venue sites (e.g. lofibrewing.com), distributed through its component release zip. It must not be installed on the Extra Chill network.
